subject: SOC2 recert + renewal: evidence cadence, retention window, and capacity uplift
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@atlasfin.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlasfin.com, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@atlasfin.com>
Date: Wed, 1 May 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 recert + renewal: initial evidence ask

Hi Vivek,

Hope you’re well. Atlas is coming up for SOC 2 recertification in Q3 and we’d like to start the evidence cadence ASAP so the audit window is smooth. A few specifics we need clarity on:

- Can Redwood support a 90-day log retention snapshot for the audit period, plus a 12-month rolling archive? We have to show chain-of-custody for logs.
- During evidence collection, auditors may request temporary increased export throughput. Can you outline options for a short-term burst and the expected lead time?
- How do you handle segmented evidence exports for different regions (we have EU and US entities)?

I’ve attached our current SOC2 report and an inventory CSV listing the artifact groups we expect to request. Procurement is looped to track commercial changes.

We’re also evaluating a 36-month renewal with a retention uplift if this is supported — want to surface that now so commercial can model it.

Thanks,
Samantha Cole
CISO, Atlas Financial
Samantha.Cole@atlasfin.com

Attachments: current-SOC2-report-2028.pdf, evidence-inventory-atlas.csv

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@atlasfin.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@atlasfin.com>, procurement@atlasfin.com
Date: Thu, 2 May 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 recert + renewal: initial evidence ask

Hi Samantha — thanks for the packet and heads-up. Appreciated.

Short summary / commitment from our side:
- Retention: We can provide a 90-day for active audit snapshots and offer an optional 12/24/36 month archival retention tier. If you convert to a 36-month committed term at renewal we can include the 12-month archive at no incremental platform fee for the first 12 months (commercial to confirm).
- Burst export: We support scheduled burst windows up to 10x baseline export throughput for up to 72 hours with 48-hour notice. For ad-hoc requests we can often accommodate within 72 hours depending on capacity.
- Regional exports: We can create segregated evidence buckets per legal entity and provide region-tagged manifests; EU data transfers will follow the standard Data Processing Addendum and we can deliver localized manifests.

I’ve attached a draft recert playbook that maps the evidence groups to our export paths and suggests an ingestion sequence to keep auditor churn low. I’m looping in Karthik (evidence ops) to confirm sequencing and Kimberly (customer success/commercial) for the renewal credit/term routing.

Next steps I propose:
1) We run a 30-minute evidence kickoff next week to align scope and auditor expectations.
2) Karthik will run a quick capacity sweep and confirm export lead times for the windows you listed.
3) Kimberly will follow up on a draft amendment that captures retention and a one-time audit credit tied to a 36-month renewal.

Would Thursday 10am PT work for the kickoff?

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments: recert-playbook-draft.docx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2029 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: internal: Atlas recert — capacity run + commercial framing

Karthik / Kim — quick internal note to prepare before Thursday’s kickoff:

Karthik: can you validate the following and send me a short bullet list I can share with Samantha ASAP?
- Baseline export throughput for Atlas account (tokens/sec / files/min) and the mechanism to scale to a 5x and 10x burst. Include lead time assumptions for 24h / 48h / 72h notifications.
- Any constraints on per-request size or per-session concurrency we should call out for the auditors.
- A light ops runbook for evidence ingestion we can hand to Atlas (3 steps: request, snapshot, confirmation with manifest).

Kimberly: commercial framing — if Atlas commits to a 36-month renewal we discussed a one-time audit credit (credits to cover snapshot export and 7-day retention staging) and a modest per-month retention uplift fee after the included period. Can you draft two options (Conservative / Aggressive) with bullet pricing and a fallback for a 12-month repurchase if they don't want 36 months?

I want to keep this tight — low friction for the customer and clear SLAs for us. Please reply inline with the bullets you want me to include in the kickoff deck.

Thanks,
Vivek

[Quoted in later outbound to customer]

From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@atlasfin.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@atlasfin.com>, procurement@atlasfin.com
Date: Mon, 6 May 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 recert + renewal: evidence cadence, retention window, and capacity uplift

Vivek — thanks, that all sounds reasonable and clear. Thursday 10am PT works for the kickoff (please send calendar invite). A couple of items from our side:

- We will likely request two burst windows during evidence collection (one for test export, one for final collection). Please mark availability for the week of Jun 10 — Jun 14.
- Confirmed that EU manifests must be delivered with pseudonymized IDs — can Redwood provide a manifest template that meets that requirement?
- Procurement would like the draft amendment and an estimate of the audit credit value (ballpark is fine ahead of commercial doc).

I’ve attached our SOC2 attestation letter for your records — happy to share the auditor contact after kickoff.

If you can ping DocuSign link after the kickoff for the amendment, procurement will triage it quickly.

Best,
Samantha Cole
CISO, Atlas Financial
